name: ui-design-pipeline
description: Turn a one-line product idea into N variant UI direction prototypes, pick one, lock a design chassis, then produce a parallel hi-fi surface wave — with deterministic validators and human approval gates at every step. Ships the information-architecture companion, an anti-AI-slop taste red-team, a ~165-system design-system catalog, audit/polish and visual-regression companions, and the Three.js / WebGL HOW layer.
